title: merchant.created.v1
description: A merchant was registered under a tenant and is in state CREATED. Published by the Merchant Registry (BC-2) on the topic pp.merchants.merchant.v1, keyed by merchant_id. Registration does not start onboarding; the Onboarding context consumes this event and waits for an explicit start.

externalReference.description: The tenant's own identifier for this merchant, if supplied. Unique within the tenant.

displayName.description: Human-readable name used in consoles and notifications.

legalName.description: Registered legal name from the business profile.

mcc.description: ISO 18245 merchant category code. Drives risk policy, gateway eligibility and prohibited-category checks.

residencyRegion.description: Determines where this merchant's personal data may live, and constrains which gateways routing may later select.

declaredMonthlyVolume.description: Self-declared expected monthly processing volume. A risk and gateway-selection input, and the baseline against which volume anomalies are measured.

selectedGateways.description: Gateway codes requested at signup. Advisory: the onboarding workflow provisions what is actually eligible.

createdBy.description: Actor identifier: an API client, a console user, or system:<component>.

money.title: Money
money.description: Integer minor units plus ISO 4217 code. Never a float, never a decimal string.
